displayName: Arkova page: Cloud Scheduler job failing repeatedly

documentation.content:
A Cloud Scheduler job has failed N consecutive times. Cloud Scheduler fired on cadence and the target did NOT succeed — a 404 (job deleted / route renamed / worker not deployed), a timeout, or a 5xx.

WHY THIS EXISTS: `generate-reports` returned `status.code: 5 NOT_FOUND` on every hourly run from 2026-03-16 for ~4.5 months (~3,300 consecutive failures) and NOTHING alerted. Every in-repo monitor (scheduler-deadman, pipeline-throughput-monitor, /health) reads worker-side state; a request the worker never receives leaves no worker-side trace at all. This policy reads the Cloud Scheduler log stream, which is the only place that failure is visible.

TRIAGE: identify `metric.label.job_id` and `metric.label.status`.
- NOT_FOUND -> the target route does not exist on the current worker revision. Either the job is obsolete (delete it) or the route regressed (fix + redeploy). Do NOT simply pause the job: an untracked pause is the 2026-06-01 daily-flush blackout shape.
- DEADLINE_EXCEEDED -> the handler exceeds the job's attemptDeadline. Make the handler async/chunked; do not raise the deadline indefinitely.
- INTERNAL / UNAVAILABLE -> worker 5xx. Check Cloud Run logs + Sentry for the same window.
- UNKNOWN -> connection reset / cold-start failure.

Any job appearing here MUST also be reconciled into `services/worker/src/jobs/scheduler-manifest.ts` (enabled, or paused WITH actor attribution). A job that is neither in the manifest nor deleted is unowned.

NOTE ON EXPECTED VOLUME AT FIRST ENABLE: as of 2026-08-01 the live Cloud Scheduler log stream carries ~464 matching failures per 24h across 11 jobs. That is not policy noise — those jobs are genuinely broken and have been silently failing. Expect an immediate burst on first enable and work the list down. Transient soak-rig jobs (`arkova-worker-*-staging-*`) are deliberately NOT excluded: a soak rig whose scheduler is erroring invalidates its own soak evidence, and per the standing infra-hygiene sweep those jobs should be deleted when the rig is torn down.
